newsitem.title: USA: Ithaca Ind files prepackaged ch 11 bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Ithaca Ind files prepackaged ch 11 bankruptcy.

text.p: Ithaca Industries Inc filed for chapter 11 protection Tuesday in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware, court papers said.
The filing included a reorganization plan for emerging from bankruptcy.

An Ithaca spokesman told Reuters the plan had been accepted by lenders and holders of its 11.25 percent senior subordinated notes and that Ithaca "does not anticipate any difficulty in completing the plan."
In court papers, Ithaca listed assets of $194.1 million and liabilities of $287.9 million.
Ithaca, of Wilkesboro, North Carolina, makes private label and branded underwear, hosiery and t-shirts.
